name: The Story Of Maple Hilarious Game For Nerds!
source:
The Story Of Maple is a hilarious unique game about a evil serial killer cat who was summoned by two nerds from the underground. Why you may ask? Because they were bored and felt the need to troll some humans above. Both Dude and Dude are massive Weeaboos, 'Minecraft' fans, and 'Undertale' players who tend to make fun of obsessive fan-bases quite a bit. (Unintentionally)  If you are looking for some good old slap-stick humor that will leave you laughing so hard that your stomach turns into a octopus and starts eating people, you must check out this game! The story of maple is a story that makes fun of pretty much everything (including itself) in a way that will leave you dying of laughter.

[From [url=https://sean12263.itch.io/the-story-of-maple-hilarious-game-for-nerds]Itch.io[/url]]
